summary: Held through two earlier dips (-33.5 and -40.75) that fully round-tripped back to flat/positive within a minute, consistent with normal chop. At t=6m the picture changed: price made a new low (-58.50, worse than any prior dip), the 1m bar showed accelerating downside velocity/acceleration, and all four recent fires (KMDR, CLIMAX, HA, PROPP) flipped to unanimously against for the first time -- prior dips only had 1-2 against fires with others still with. That unanimous-against confluence plus a fresh low breaking the prior range was the wrong-direction signature, so I bailed. Next time I'd watch for the transition from mixed/against-with fires to full unanimity across detector families combined with a new extreme as the trigger, rather than reacting to raw pts drawdown alone.
